target_customer: Industrial distributors, wholesalers and manufacturers in Germany and the US that receive orders by email and PDF
problem: Sales teams re-key purchase orders, RFQs and tender lists from emails, PDFs and Excel into the ERP by hand.
business_model: B2B SaaS AI agents for order entry, pricing not stated
product_category: AI order and quote entry automation

founders.name: Jiehua Wu
education: Technical University of Munich, BSc Computer Science and Business

founders.name: Almo Sutedjo
education: Technical University of Munich, BSc Computer Science

technical_complexity.rationale: Document extraction with LLMs is accessible, but matching to customer article numbers and writing into many ERPs reliably is the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations and product master matching give some lock-in, but extraction itself is commoditised.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A February 2026 profile flagged that Epicor could build the extraction layer natively; no acquisition found.

market_need_then: German wholesalers still process orders by email and PDF; company claims 75 to 99 percent time saving and named four German customers on its site.

identity.voice_and_tone: Formal, benefit-focused German copy addressing readers as Sie, for example 'Weniger Tippen, mehr Verkaufen'

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community about the brand; the name is a short coinage with no stated meaning.

outcome_analysis: Comena is an active Munich company from the Summer 2025 batch with a team of 8 and named German distributor customers. Funding reports conflict and are unverified, so the outcome cannot be judged. Founders have YC startup experience and TUM backgrounds, but incumbents like Epicor own adjacent products.
notes: Funding unverified: VCBacked and FundedIQ list 500K pre-seed in September 2025, other trackers list a January 2025 seed of 500K, Simplify Jobs mentions a 2.5M seed in April 2026 and 130K total; none from a primary source, so no rounds recorded. Competitor pages are undated vendor pages, not strictly dated to the batch. Team size 8 on YC page versus about 13 in another listing. Competitors found (Conexiom, WizCommerce) came from undated vendor pages, so the dated list is left empty.
